brief: Thomas More was born in 1478. He was renowned for his charm, wit and integrity, and for his strict spiritual discipline. As lord chancellor of England, he supported Henry VIII’s moves to reform the clergy. However, loyal to his Catholic heritage, he consistently opposed Henry’s plans for divorce and re-marriage to secure a legitimate heir. More refused to accept the Act of Supremacy in 1535 that declared the king “only supreme head of the Church in England”, and was executed for treason on 6 July that year.
